诱杀（诱杀（第22页）他看向其他表情也一脸诡异的苍玄弟子。“不着急，等猎物多一点再说，不然不够分。”只是下一瞬。他看到了一道猩红色的刀光闪过。他下意识的往后看了看。就看到了他身后的那些弟子，脖子上，整齐的出现了一道血线。几息后。一颗颗的人头，接连掉落。那些人的表情，还维持着头没有掉之前的表情。他的身体有些颤抖。只是脸上的表情，还是那个笑容。他举着刀，“谁，是谁，出来？”听到这话，林罪走了出去。对方一看到他，声音有些发抖的问道，“那一道沟壑，是你弄的？”林罪点点头，“随手一刀罢了。”“不可能，即使是四骨人仙，也不可能轻易的劈出那一刀。”“且这个遗境，上限是三骨人仙。”“我知道了，你在扰乱我的思绪。”他一脚踢在不远处的弟子身上，“醒来，给我醒来。”林罪笑了笑，“会不会，我进入之前就是三骨，然后进来后，突破了四骨呢？”话落。林罪没有给对方说话的机会。还有不少人等着他杀，多耽搁一秒都是浪费。他一刀斩出。任由对方抵抗，他的那颗脑袋，依旧冲天而起。掉落在地上的时候，眼里是惊悚，嘴角的表情，依旧挂着笑。林罪拿出坐忘石。刚好四十人，可以给他增加多少块仙骨？坐忘石飞到半空，浑身遍布裂纹，嘴巴张得巨大，眼睛活灵活现。四十条猩红妖异的触手，涌向四十人。林罪露出笑意。没想到坐忘石还有这个功能，一个个吞噬，那得耗费多长时间。触手灵活的剥开每一个人的皮肤。优先吞噬他们破凡成仙的仙骨。再吞噬仙骨雏形。……胡杀神色有些恐惧的看着一嘴是血的伊凡。“祁山长生宗，怎么会有你这种吃人的怪物，出去后，你一定会死。”“分开跑。”说完，还活着的十几个弟子，朝着不同的方向跑去。伊凡舔了舔嘴角的鲜血。身上涌现一股奇异的能量，往不同方向跑的弟子，突然大喊大叫。“怎么会有一个深渊？救救我。”“该死，哪里来的二阶巨蟒。”“父亲，妹妹不是我杀的。”“……”胡一大惊，“妖孽。”他迅速冲向前，一剑斩下。让他没有想到的是，他这一剑，居然将伊凡的身体斩成两节。还没等他回过神来，他的心脏，已经扎进了一柄剑。……权一，高渊看着眼前，杀人必将人撕裂成无数小块的女人。心中产生了不妙的感觉。“所有人，全力杀死她。”趁着其他弟子冲上前的时候，他和高渊，转身就逃。可是等待他们的，是从地面突然出现的锁链。将他们完全缠住，捆得紧紧的。锁链不断流动，砰的一声。两人的尸体炸成漫天碎块。……坐忘石飞到林罪眉心。和坐忘石的眼睛对视，林罪发现，那双眼睛，在倒映着他的模样。他的全身，长满了猩红触手。触手扎破他的眉心，注入的仙骨能量，超越以往。……

Booby (Page 22) He looked at the other Cangxuan disciples who also had strange expressions. "Don't worry, wait until there are more prey, otherwise it won't be enough." Just the next moment, he saw a scarlet sword flash. He looked back subconsciously and saw the disciples behind him, with a line of blood neatly appearing on their necks. A few breaths later, heads fell one after another. Those people's His expression was still the same as before his head fell off. His body was shaking a little. But the expression on his face was still the same. He held up the knife, "Who, come out?" Upon hearing this, Lin Zui walked out. When the other party saw him, he asked with a trembling voice, "Did you make that ravine?" Lin Zui nodded, "It was just a casual blow." "Impossible, even a four-bone human being can't do it lightly. Yi's slash. "The upper limit of this relic is a three-bone human immortal." "I know, you are disturbing my thoughts." He kicked the disciple not far away. "Wake up, wake up." Lin Zui smiled, "Is it possible that I entered with three bones and then broke through four bones?" Lin Zui did not give the other party a chance to speak. There are many people waiting for him to kill. It was a waste of seconds. Despite the opponent's resistance, his head still shot up into the sky. When it fell to the ground, his eyes were filled with horror, and the expression on his mouth was still there. Lin Zui took out the Zuowang Stone. How many immortal bones could he add to it? Lin Zui smiled. He didn't expect the Zuowang Stone to have this ability. How long would it take to devour each person's skin, and then devour their immortal bones first? ... Hu Sha looked at Ivan with a mouth full of blood. "How can there be a man-eating monster like you in the Qishan Changsheng Sect?" "You will definitely die after you get out." "After that, the dozen disciples who were still alive ran in different directions. Ivan licked the blood from the corner of his mouth. A strange energy emerged from his body, and the disciples who ran in different directions suddenly shouted. "Why is there an abyss? Help me." "Damn it, where did the second-level python come from?" "Father, I didn't kill the sister." He was shocked, "Monster" He rushed forward with a sword. What he didn't expect was that his sword actually cut Ivan's body into two pieces. Before he could recover, a sword had already penetrated his heart. ... Quan Yi, Gao Yuan felt something bad in his heart as he looked at the woman in front of him. "Everyone, kill her with all your strength." While other disciples rushed forward, he and Gao Yuan turned around and ran away. Theirs were chains that suddenly appeared from the ground. The chains continued to flow, and with a bang, the two bodies flew into pieces. Lin Zui looked into Lin Zui's eyes. His whole body was covered with scarlet tentacles.
